description:
Business Development Manager, Army – NODA AI

Location: Remote, US (With approximately 30% travel supporting customer engagements, demonstrations, and industry events)

Clearance Requirement: U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

About NODA

NODA is a Veteran-owned, venture-backed technology company that is transforming how unmanned systems collaborate in complex, mission-critical environments. We are developing next-generation solutions that enable the autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous unmanned systems across air, sea, land, and space with vital applications in the defense, intelligence, and commercial sectors.

Our Business Development team plays a critical role in shaping how autonomous systems are adopted across the defense enterprise, influencing requirements before they are written, shaping acquisition strategies before they are released, and accelerating the transition of next-generation autonomy capabilities from concept to operational deployment.

Joining NODA means working on meaningful technology that pushes the boundaries of autonomy alongside a team that thrives on innovation, rapid iteration, and collaboration.

The Role

We are seeking a Business Development Manager to lead growth across the U.S. Army community. This is not an account management role. This is a builder's role.

You will identify emerging mission needs, establish trusted relationships across the Army Operations enterprise, influence acquisition strategies, and lead opportunities from initial engagement through contract award. You will work directly with operators, acquisition professionals, Program Executive Offices, prime contractors, and industry partners to position NODA where our technology creates operational advantage.

Success in this role requires initiative, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and opportunities are often created rather than assigned. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing operational challenges with end users, technical integration with engineers, and acquisition strategy with senior government leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute NODA's business development strategy across Army and adjacent mission organizations.

  • Build trusted relationships with operators, mission planners, acquisition professionals, contracting officers, program offices, innovation organizations, prime contractors, and senior government stakeholders to influence future requirements and identify growth opportunities.

  • Identify, qualify, and advance strategic opportunities through the capture lifecycle from initial customer engagement through contract award and transition to execution.

  • Develop and maintain a healthy multi-quarter pipeline while delivering accurate forecasting, opportunity qualification, and disciplined CRM management.

  • Lead capture planning, including competitive assessments, solution shaping, teaming strategies, pricing support, proposal development, win themes, bid/no-bid recommendations, and executive gate reviews.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Mission Operations, Contracts, and Executive Leadership to align customer priorities with NODA's product roadmap and growth strategy.

  • Navigate FAR-based contracts, OTAs, CSOs, SBIR/STTR, IDIQs, SOFWERX, DIU, AFWERX, and other rapid acquisition mechanisms.

  • Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with prime contractors, systems integrators, emerging technology companies, academia, and mission partners.

  • Represent NODA at demonstrations, operational exercises, and industry events including SOF Week, NDIA, AUSA, AFA, and Modern Day Marine.

  • Monitor mission priorities, acquisition strategies, funding, competitive activity, and capability gaps to inform executive decision-making and drive long-term growth strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in business development, capture management, defense sales, or related DoD roles, including significant experience developing and growing business opportunities within the U.S. Army market.

  • Experience working directly with U.S. Department of Defense stakeholders, particularly within the U.S. Army, Combatant Commands, and the Intelligence Community, including operational units, program offices, acquisition organizations, and other key service organizations.

  • Established relationships across the U.S. Army enterprise, including Army acquisition organizations, program offices, operational units, key stakeholders, and relevant prime contractors.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, qualify, and mature opportunities, resulting in a measurable pipeline of opportunities aligned with company growth objectives.

  • Demonstrated success winning new business from customer engagement through contract award

  • Deep familiarity with the U.S. Army enterprise, including its organizational structure, acquisition organizations, capability development lifecycle, budget cycles, and procurement processes.

  • Understanding of Army modernization priorities, including areas such as autonomous systems, AI-enabled capabilities, robotics, multi-domain operations, and digital transformation initiatives.

  • Experience with FAR-based contracting and non-traditional acquisition pathways including OTAs, CSOs, SBIR/STTR, IDIQs, and rapid acquisition efforts

  • Ability to engage credibly in technical discussions involving autonomy, AI-enabled software, robotics, interoperability, and unmanned systems

  • Experience conducting market assessments, identifying emerging opportunities, and developing account strategies, capture plans, competitive positioning, win strategies, and long-term growth plans within the U.S. Army market.

  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of military, government, and industry experience

  • Ability to travel approximately 30%

  • Due to the nature of the position, U.S. citizenship is required due to ITAR regulations, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior service in the U.S. Army community or extensive experience supporting SOF organizations

  • Existing relationships across USSOCOM Headquarters, TSOCs, SOF AT&L, SOFWERX, DIU, DARPA, NavalX, AFWERX, or other defense innovation organizations

  • Experience supporting autonomous systems, AI-enabled software, unmanned systems, ISR, C5ISR, robotics, mission autonomy, or adjacent defense technologies

  • Experience working within a venture-backed or high-growth defense technology company

  • Experience supporting demonstrations, experimentation campaigns, or technology transition efforts

  • Active Top Secret or TS/SCI security clearance

  • Mission-first mindset with a passion for delivering operational advantage to the warfighter

  • Builder mentality with the initiative to create opportunities and shape markets rather than wait for them

  • Technically curious, with the ability to translate complex autonomy and AI concepts into mission value

  • Comfortable operating independently in ambiguous startup environments where priorities evolve quickly

Skills & Attributes

  • Strategic thinker who connects customer challenges with business growth and product strategy

  • Exceptional relationship builder with strong executive presence across government, industry, and the operator community

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity tracking

  • Collaborative partner across Engineering, Product, Operations, Contracts, and Leadership

  • Resilient, adaptable, accountable, and results-oriented

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage with zero paycheck medical premiums for you and your family, plus supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage

  • Free 24/7 mental health support, including therapy, plus legal and financial assistance

  • Equity grants for new hires, giving you ownership in the company and a share in its success

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Employer-funded HSA contributions, plus FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and lifestyle expenses

  • Unlimited PTO, 11 paid holidays, and company-wide holiday breaks in July and December

  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Military leave to support our team members’ annual training and service commitments

  • Professional development, including conferences, certifications, continuing education, and job-specific training

  • Weekly meal credits and stocked kitchens at eligible office locations

  • Pet insurance options to help keep your furry family members covered

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.
